title: Bicycles
passage: Bicycles are popular in Japan. People use them to go to school or to the station. Riding a bike is good for the environment, so many people like using bicycles.
pictureAlt: A town street. A man is riding a bicycle. A girl is standing in front of an ice cream shop, thinking about buying an ice cream.

questions.text: Please look at the passage. Why do many people like using bicycles?
questions.tip: “so” の前を探そう。主語を変えて “Because riding a bike …” で答えよう。
questions.model: Because riding a bike is good for the environment.

questions.text: Please look at the picture. What is the man doing?
Please look at the girl. What is she going to do?
questions.tip: 吹き出しを見よう。“She is going to …” で答えよう。
questions.model: She is going to buy an ice cream.

questions.text: How do you come to school?
questions.tip: 自分のことを文で答えよう。“I … to school.”

questions.text: Do you like riding a bike?
questions.tip: まず Yes か No で答えよう。
questions.model: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

followYes.tip: もう1文、くわしく言おう。
followYes.model: I often ride my bike to the park with my friends.

followNo.model: Because I can't ride a bike well.
